pliance with warning of drug interactions provided by prescription automatic screening system and quality of information
SHI Hui-qing, YONG Xiao-lan, HU Ting-ting (Department of Pharmacy, General Hospital of Chengdu Military Region, Chengdu 610083, China)[ABSTRACT] Objective: To investigate the relationship between doctors' compliance and quality of information provided by prescription automatic screening system(PASS). Methods: Daily warnings of drug interactions through PASS were collected in three departments, which were randomly chosen from all the medical departments, during August 15-24, 2005 in General Hospital of Chengdu Military Region. Then the relationship between doctors' compliance and PASS information quality was evaluated by pharmacists based on the questionnaires filled by doctors. Results: The two main factors influencing doctors' decisions were easy to follow the advice given by PASS and conformation between advice and clinical practice. Conclusion: Correct explanation and reasonable advice given by pharmacists are helpful to doctors for making better use of PASS information.[Pharm Care & Res, 2006, 6(6): 427-429]处方自动筛选系统（prescription automatic screening system，PASS）嵌入军队医院信息系统（HIS），可对用药医嘱进行实时监测，对有可能导致不良事件的医嘱及时进行警告，不仅对医生及时提醒，同时也为药师协助临床合理用药提供了新的平台。对PASS信息进行合理解释，并结合临床实际情况提出合理的解决方案，是临床药师的工作之一，而这一工作的前提是了解临床医师对警示的关注程度。为了明确PASS信息的哪些内容对医生做出的决策具有较大的影响，作者对临床医生对PASS警示的依从性与信息质量的相关性进行了分析。
